plugins.name: md-to-html
plugins.description: Documents as an MD + HTML pair: Claude writes only Markdown, the HTML is generated by pandoc at zero token cost. Multilingual UI (English, Bulgarian, extensible).

plugins.name: web-research
plugins.description: Token-efficient web research: searches run in cheap Haiku subagents with explicit limits - a fast WebSearch/WebFetch researcher and a real-browser researcher (Playwright) for JavaScript-heavy or interactive pages - so raw page content never reaches the main conversation.
